annotations.title: Compare a redesign before and after

description: For a redesign with a base screen (the page as it was): writes a before/after page beside the design (one section per page of a collection) with the old and new pages at desktop (1440×900) and phone (390×844) sizes, a drag slider and side-by-side view, and capture times. When the site was audited (audit_open_design_site), each audit problem for that page is re-checked on the design with the same check at the same size and shown as fixed only if it passes, otherwise as still open (page weight isn't re-checked). Lists every copy edit (data-od-copy-edit) with its original. Optional summary lines must each cite fixed findings by id; a line that cites nothing or an open finding is left out and reported. The page is one self-contained HTML file, registered as its own design, so preview, PDF export (one page per screen) and publish work on it; a flow's published site links to it from the map. Needs a browser to capture the design.

collectionId.description: Every page of a redesign planned as a flow. Give this or entryPath.

entryPath.description: One redesigned page. Give this or collectionId.

summary.description: Optional: up to 3 summary lines for the top of the page. Run once without it to see which findings are fixed, then again with lines that cite them.

cites.description: The ids of the fixed findings the line rests on, e.g. ["F1", "F3"].

text.description: One short line for the client (at most 160 characters), e.g. "The booking button is now readable and on the first phone screen."
